newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM net up 13 pct, sees higher full year.
newsitem.headline: DSM net up 13 pct, sees higher full year.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV on Wednesday reported 1997 first-half net profit up 13 percent at 465 million guilders and predicted "clearly higher" earnings for the full year.
"Favourable market circumstances and the expansion of our activities have resulted in strong sales growth," DSM director Loek Ligthart said.

He said turnover jumped 18 percent year-on-year to 6.1 billion guilders. Sales volumes increased by 11 percent, while sales prices of plastics and fine chemicals rose four percent and exchange rate effects has a positive impact of three pct.
